assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md, section '#### Environment / Version' quotes '> Not sure which version — using whatever is deployed on staging.' The required-sections table lists 'Environment / Version | ### **Environment / Version** | yes (present, but contains no version identifier)', and a parsing note says the content is vague and has no version identifier.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.2 – Extract version from description' scans for three patterns (explicit number, product-prefixed, version keyword + number) and finds no match for any of them. It concludes 'Classification: **vague text**' and 'Result: **no version could be extracted** → ... skip 4.5.3 ..., 4.5.4 ... and 4.5.5 ..., and go directly to 4.5.6.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.6 – Flag gap' has the comment body '> Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' The ADF text node has the same exact text, inside 'jira.add_comment("ACME-511", <ADF below>)'.

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md 4.5.6 comment body ends with '---' and 'This comment was AI-generated by [sdlc-workflow/triage-bug](https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins) v0.14.0.' The ADF has a {"type": "rule"} node followed by a paragraph with the text 'This comment was AI-generated by ', the link 'sdlc-workflow/triage-bug' (href https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins) and ' v0.14.0.'. This matches the structure in plugins/sdlc-workflow/shared/comment-footnote.md.
